overall: 15 VERIFIED rows: 12 confirmed, 3 discrepancy, 0 failed. Every probe reached its expected text. Most serious: sd-opinions-ujs says 'always add archive=true', but that flag returns ONLY archived opinions, so the record's own probe (2026 S.D. 48) and other recent opinions return 0 hits with it; search without the flag first, then with it. Same switch behaviour on rule orders and summary dispositions. Also: bare SDCL rule parents (15-6-26) return a catchline-only page (33 chars), not 0, defeating the empty-page rule; unknown keys return 404, not empty 200; SDR register RSS has no dates, so SDR cites cannot be resolved practically. Justia lettered keys are lowercase (title-23a). Regexes route well; 'SD Codified Laws' (no periods) misses.
